attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012109215 (CC0): the buff-brick Amsterdam School front with its white three-light school windows, the two banded round stair towers with curved stair windows and toothed crowns, the spire piers and brick teeth of the middle bay, its one-storey projection on a dark plinth, the parapet lattice band, the entrance canopies with the HUIS VAN DE WIJK sign and the planter walls, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0) and Commons photos by Alf van Beem (CC0). No pixels or meshes imported.
